tasks.details: Run EF Core migrations as a deploy step (or startup migrator with a production safeguard) per environment.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrations apply automatically for each environment
steps: Generate an idempotent SQL script per service: `dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent -o out.sql`.
Add a deploy step that applies scripts before the new revision starts taking traffic.
Never auto-migrate on startup in production - gate it behind an explicit flag.
Take a database backup/snapshot immediately before applying.
Test the whole flow against the staging database first.

tasks.title: Deploy with environment approvals
tasks.details: Deploy to dev/staging/prod (Azure Container Apps) with manual approval gates and per-environment secrets.
acceptanceCriteria: Promotion to production requires approval
steps: Create GitHub environments: dev, staging, prod.
Add required reviewers on prod so promotion needs an approval.
Store per-environment configuration as environment secrets/variables.
Add the deploy job using `az containerapp update` with the new image tag.
Deploy dev automatically, staging on merge, prod on approval.
Confirm a prod deploy pauses for approval.

tasks.title: Post-deploy smoke checks
tasks.details: Run health/smoke checks after each deployment and auto-rollback or alert on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed smoke checks block or roll back the release
steps: After deployment, poll /health/ready for each service until healthy or a timeout.
Run a small smoke script: log in, list studies, fetch the gateway health aggregate.
On failure, roll back by re-activating the previous Container Apps revision.
Post the result to the pull request or a chat channel.
Test the rollback path deliberately once so you know it works.

sections.name: Azure Infrastructure (IaC) & Production Deployment
sections.goal: All Azure resources provisioned via Bicep and the system running in production on Azure Container Apps with managed identities, private networking, autoscaling, monitoring, and cost controls.

tasks.title: Author Bicep modules for core resources
tasks.details: Bicep for Resource Group, ACR, Container Apps Environment, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
acceptanceCriteria: `az deployment` provisions the core resources
steps: Create infra/main.bicep plus a modules/ folder.
Write modules for the resource group scope: ACR, Log Analytics workspace, Application Insights, Container Apps Environment.
Parameterise environment name, location and a resource-name prefix.
Add a parameter file per environment (dev/staging/prod).
Deploy with `az deployment sub create -f main.bicep -p @dev.bicepparam` and confirm the resources exist.

tasks.title: Provision data and messaging resources
tasks.details: Bicep for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Service Bus, and Blob Storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Data, cache, bus, and storage provisioned via IaC
steps: Add a Postgres Flexible Server module with the version, SKU, storage and backup retention.
Add Azure Cache for Redis and Azure Service Bus (Standard tier or higher for topics).
Add a Storage Account with a private container for DICOM.
Create the per-service databases/schemas via a post-deploy script.
Output the connection details as Key Vault references, never as plaintext outputs.

tasks.title: Provision Key Vault and managed identities
tasks.details: Bicep for Key Vault and user-assigned managed identities with scoped RBAC role assignments per service.
acceptanceCriteria: Services authenticate to Azure via managed identity
steps: Add a Key Vault module with RBAC authorization enabled.
Create one user-assigned managed identity per service.
Assign Key Vault Secrets User to each identity, scoped as narrowly as possible.
Assign AcrPull to the identities that run containers.
Store the JWT signing key and connection strings as secrets.
Verify a service can read its secret and cannot read another's.

tasks.title: Deploy Container Apps with configuration
tasks.details: Deploy each service, the gateway, and the Blazor app as Container Apps, wiring Key Vault references and Service Bus/Redis/Postgres connections.
acceptanceCriteria: All apps run in the Container Apps environment
steps: Add a Container App module taking the image, identity, env vars and secret references.
Deploy each service, the gateway and the Blazor app with it.
Wire configuration to Key Vault references so no secret is inline.
Set ingress: external for the gateway and web app, internal for the services.
Enable Dapr or plain internal DNS for service-to-service names.
Confirm every app reports healthy in the portal.

tasks.title: Networking and private endpoints
tasks.details: Add VNet integration and private endpoints for Postgres/Redis/Key Vault/Storage; restrict public access.
acceptanceCriteria: Data services are not publicly reachable
steps: Add a VNet with subnets for the Container Apps environment and private endpoints.
Create private endpoints for Postgres, Redis, Key Vault and Storage.
Add the private DNS zones and link them to the VNet.
Set publicNetworkAccess to Disabled on those resources.
Verify from outside the VNet that the database is unreachable.

tasks.title: Autoscaling, custom domain, and TLS
tasks.details: Configure Container Apps scale rules, a custom domain, and managed TLS certificates.
acceptanceCriteria: Apps autoscale and the custom domain is served over TLS
steps: Add scale rules per app: HTTP concurrency for the gateway and web, queue length for consumers.
Set minReplicas to 1 for latency-sensitive apps and 0 for batch workers.
Add the custom domain and a managed certificate on the gateway and web app.
Force HTTPS-only ingress.
Load-test briefly and watch replicas scale.

tasks.title: Monitoring dashboards and cost alerts
tasks.details: Build App Insights / Log Analytics dashboards and alerts (errors, latency, lock contention) and set budget alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboards live and alerts fire on threshold breaches
steps: Build an Application Insights dashboard: request rate, p95 latency, error rate, dependency failures.
Add domain metrics: lock contention, studies by status, import failures, payment failures.
Create alerts for error-rate spikes, health-check failures and dead-letter depth.
Add a budget with alerts at 50/80/100 percent.
Set log retention deliberately - audit and access logs usually need longer.

tasks.title: Production runbook and DR plan
tasks.details: Document deploy/rollback runbook, Postgres/Blob backup-restore, and a disaster-recovery RTO/RPO plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Runbook and DR plan reviewed and stored in docs/
steps: Write docs/runbook.md: how to deploy, how to roll back, who to contact.
Document the restore procedure for Postgres point-in-time and for blob.
State the RTO and RPO targets and how the current configuration meets them.
Add the incident checklist: triage, communicate, mitigate, write the post-mortem.
Actually rehearse a restore into a scratch database once and record how long it took.
Review the runbook with anyone else who might have to run it.
